description.summary: This table details the insurance payout for a vehicle declared a total loss or constructive total loss, specifically addressing scenarios where taxes haven't been fully paid. It outlines how benefits are calculated and the insurer's rights to the vehicle afterward.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח לרכב פרטי ומסחרי עד 35 טון מתייחסת למקרה של אובדן מוחלט או אובדן בנייה מחדש של הרכב. במקרה כזה, הפיצוי ישולם בהתאם לשווי הרכב לפני האירוע הביטוחי, כאילו שולמו כל המיסים, או שהרכב יוחלף ברכב דומה. במקרה של אובדן רכב בו לא שולמו מיסים, הפיצוי ישולם בהתאם לשווי הרכב ללא מיסים.

sketch:
7. Loss of a Vehicle for which Taxes Were Not Paid
7.1 Notwithstanding whatsoever stated in paragraph 5.2, in the event of total loss or constructive total loss of the vehicle due to an insured event covered by this policy, where not all the government taxes were paid on the vehicle or in respect
of which V.A.T. has been set-off,  and the insurer decides not to repair the vehicle, the insurer will pay insurance the insurance benefits according to the value of the vehicle excluding taxes or excluding V.A.T. as the case may be, or  will replace the vehicle with another vehicle of similar type and quality.
7.2 Notwithstanding whatsoever stated in sub-paragraph 7.1, if the insured furnishes to the Insurer proof that it is not entitled to a repeat exemption from taxes or V.A.T. set-off, as the case may be. In regard to a replacement vehicle which it intends to purchase in place of the vehicle which sustained total loss or constructive total loss, the insurer will pay him insurance benefits according to the value of the vehicle prior to the occurrence of the insured event as if all the taxes had been paid in regard thereto, or will replace the vehicle with a vehicle of similar type and quality.
7.3 After payment of the insurance benefits or replacement of the vehicle, the insurer will be entitled to take over from the insured his rights in the vehicle, except for accessories and assemblies, in regard to which the insured will not be entitled to insurance benefits; if the said transfer of the rights depends on payment of any taxes, such payment will be borne by the Insurer.

טבלה: אובדן רכב
This table details the insurance payout for a vehicle declared a total loss or constructive total loss, specifically addressing scenarios where taxes haven't been fully paid. It outlines how benefits are calculated and the insurer's rights to the vehicle afterward.

7. Loss of a Vehicle for which Taxes Were Not Paid
7.1 Notwithstanding whatsoever stated in paragraph 5.2, in the event of total loss or constructive total loss of the vehicle due to an insured event covered by this policy, where not all the government taxes were paid on the vehicle or in respect
of which V.A.T. has been set-off,  and the insurer decides not to repair the vehicle, the insurer will pay insurance the insurance benefits according to the value of the vehicle excluding taxes or excluding V.A.T. as the case may be, or  will replace the vehicle with another vehicle of similar type and quality.
7.2 Notwithstanding whatsoever stated in sub-paragraph 7.1, if the insured furnishes to the Insurer proof that it is not entitled to a repeat exemption from taxes or V.A.T. set-off, as the case may be. In regard to a replacement vehicle which it intends to purchase in place of the vehicle which sustained total loss or constructive total loss, the insurer will pay him insurance benefits according to the value of the vehicle prior to the occurrence of the insured event as if all the taxes had been paid in regard thereto, or will replace the vehicle with a vehicle of similar type and quality.
7.3 After payment of the insurance benefits or replacement of the vehicle, the insurer will be entitled to take over from the insured his rights in the vehicle, except for accessories and assemblies, in regard to which the insured will not be entitled to insurance benefits; if the said transfer of the rights depends on payment of any taxes, such payment will be borne by the Insurer.
